body.name: Corrected actual-row class \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{soft}}(G)\)
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{soft}}(G)=\{G':\overline{G'}=\overline G,\text{ for every }\theta\in\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{term},p,q}(G,G')\text{ there exists }U=I_q-\Lambda'^{(0)}\text{ with exact support }G'\text{ such that }h_k^{\mathsf T}U\text{ has exact support }\operatorname{pa}_{G'}(k)\text{ and every candidate edge remains nonzero after its change for all }k\in V\}\).
